title: Custer
lyrics:
[00:31.59]RISE
[00:40.01]Half alive and stark-raving free and maligned for encroaching on the purpose of this commercial-free interruption…
[00:48.07]Due to the prolific nature of this statement, listener aggression is advised.
[00:54.25]It's strange; whenever I see a gun, I think about just how petty you are
[00:58.04]And it blows my **** mind- Yeah, it blows my **** mind
[01:01.66]These days, I never seem to get enough. I'm tired of this ****- I want to go home
[01:05.51]Don't waste my **** time- don't waste my **** time
[01:09.27]Because anything exceptional gets crushed by common people
[01:12.86]With jealousy and ignorance and all their common evils
[01:16.63]This planet isn't special- collections made of clay
[01:20.29]I'm waiting for the punishment I know is on my way
[01:24.10]So cut/cut/cut me up and ****/****/**** me up
[01:28.10]CUT/CUT/CUT ME UP AND ****/****/**** ME UP
[01:48.14]Irreverence is my disease- it's second hand but you know me
[01:55.43]The Son of a **** is on his knees- the Last Man Standing gets no pity
[02:08.31]Somewhere on a toilet wall, I read the words
[02:10.84]'You FORM A LINE to FORMALIZE the FORMER LIES' and I finally saw the truth
[02:15.45]Something so profound and it was sitting there, surrounded by
[02:18.98]The garbage and the stains- another victim of the refuse
[02:22.52]Now I've been saying this for years but you don't comprehend it
[02:26.28]I fight hell and I fight fear because I understand it
[02:29.75]Androgyny and insults- you try so hard to be difficult
[02:33.78]You want to win the war? Know what you're fighting for.
[02:37.09]So cut/cut/cut me up and ****/****/**** me up
[02:40.88]CUT/CUT/CUT ME UP AND ****/****/**** ME UP
[03:00.92]Irreverence is my disease- it's second hand but you know me
[03:08.17]The Son of a **** is on his knees- the Last Man Standing gets no pity
[03:15.34]With Angel Eyes and Demon seeds- you're missing what you really need
[03:22.60]When all is said and done, you see- the Last Man Standing gets no pity
[03:49.34]Cut/cut/cut me up and ****/****/**** me up
